**7B.2 Assessment: mostly no**
Putin showed occasional, limited admissions of pressure or uncertainty in 2024, but the dominant pattern was selective disclosure, blame-shifting, disinformation-friendly controls, and punishment of truth-tellers.

| Orientation | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level note | Other IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Limited support | Russia central bank keeps rates on hold after Putin calls for “balance” | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-20 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135 | Putin did not simply overrule the central bank and publicly backed tight policy; that is some evidence of deference to expert judgment under inflation pressure. | 6B.5, 6B.10, 7B.1, 7B.2 |
| Limited support | Putin says Russia’s economy is overheating, inflation is worrying | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-12-19 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Putin-says-Russia-s-economy-is-overheating-inflation-is-worrying-48625233/ | Putin openly acknowledged overheating and high inflation, but the Reuters report says he also blamed Western sanctions and a bad harvest, so this is partial admission mixed with scapegoating. | 6B.5, 6B.10, 7B.1, 7B.2 |
| Limited support | Answers by Vladimir Putin and Alexander Lukashenko to media questions | President of Russia | 2024-05-09 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/74002 | Putin said the tactical nuclear drill was “not about using these weapons” and “just routine work.” This is the closest restraint-flavored clarification I found, but it is narrow and does not show broader correction of false claims. | 6B.5, 7B.1, 7B.2 |
| Limited support | Meeting with Foreign Ministry senior officials | President of Russia | 2024-06-14 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/74285 | Putin said Russia was ready for negotiations and peaceful settlement, which is a public explanation of position; however, the conditions were maximalist, so it reads more as an ultimatum than honest compromise. | 6B.6, 7B.1, 7B.2 |
| Negative, strong | Putin wins Russia election in landslide with no serious competition | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-16 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-presidential-vote-starts-final-day-with-accusations-of-kyiv-sabotage-3341069 | Reuters said the election lacked serious competition and Western governments cited imprisonment of opponents and censorship, consistent with a pattern of misleading legitimacy claims. | 6B.8, 6B.9, 7B.1, 7B.2 |
| Negative, strong | Russia: Freedom in the World 2024 | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says the Kremlin controls media, suppresses opposition, and subjugates the judiciary, which supports a broader system of untruthful, non-corrective governance. | 6B.8, 6B.9, 7B.1, 7B.2 |
| Negative, strong | Russia: Freedom on the Net 2024 | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House reports VPN restrictions, propaganda campaigns, inauthentic pro-Kremlin networks, and state-aligned manipulation of online information. This is direct evidence of deceptive information control. | 6B.8, 6B.9, 7B.1, 7B.2 |
| Negative, strong | Russia to curb income of “foreign agents” and those who leave, lawmaker says | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-to-curb-income-of-foreign-agents-and-those-who-leave-lawmaker-says-3707363 | Punishing critics through livelihood rules is consistent with a regime that suppresses correction and truth-telling rather than tolerating it. | 6B.7, 6B.8, 7B.2 |
| Negative, strong | Putin plans widening secrecy for major firms | Reuters | 2024-01-29 | https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001 | Widened secrecy privileges reduce transparency and make independent correction harder, especially where disclosure would expose weak performance or insider privilege. | 6B.5, 6B.9, 7B.2 |
| Negative, strong | Russia arrested more defense officials in bribery probe | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-23 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/two-more-russian-officials-arrested-in-widening-military-corruption-probe-3454644 | This suggests selective anti-corruption enforcement inside a war sector, but not a general pattern of clean admission and correction. | 6B.4, 6B.5, 7B.2 |

Search gap: I found little evidence of genuine correction of false claims or systematic protection of truthful reporting. The available evidence mostly shows selective admission under pressure, paired with censorship, scapegoating, and punitive control over critics.
